State the assumptions that make the single-quadrature variance bound valid, including independent outcomes in [-1,1], total shot allocation and amplitude coefficients; if the retained evidence cannot fix those conventions, withdraw the quantitative bound and retain the qualitative precision caveat. Define u(R) as the proposed Hamiltonian minus the reference Hamiltonian, with its induction-only restriction.
